newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY CEN.BANK EXTENDS HELP TO RUN-HIT POSTABANK.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY CEN.BANK EXTENDS HELP TO RUN-HIT POSTABANK.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Tuesday that it extended a one-month temporary exemption from the placing of obligatory reserves with the NBH, to Postabank, which was hit by panic withdrawals recently.
The NBH extended the deadline of the exemption to June 30 from April 15, while it said the exemption will be only partial from April 16.
Between April 16 and June 30, Postabank will have to place 50 percent of its obligatory reserves with the NBH, while in the month to April 15, it enjoyed 100 percent exemption.

"The bank... has prepared a liquidity plan, which is aimed mainly at firming the solvency of the bank firmer," the NBH said in a statement, adding that the extension of the deadline should help Postabank to carry out its plan.
Depositors withdrew around 24 billion forints at the end of February from Postabank in a four-day-long rumour-triggered panic wave.
According to press reports, the original one-month exemption freed some 20 billion forints at the bank.
The government is engaged in talks with Postabank about a possible government-backed subordinated loan to the bank.
